title: The Harvest of Harrow Glen
author: P. M. Lockridge
blurb: Juniper Lockridge, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
